answer: New identities are admitted only when three established agents each lock a voucher against them for six epochs. The voucher is a cipher over the sponsor's stake nonce and the applicant's address, posted before any answer can be sealed. Each sponsor may issue at most two vouchers per epoch; if the newcomer later fails an audit, those sponsors are slashed at the nadir of their unbonding window, when fee income cannot quickly refill the loss. A public signal then names the failed cluster, so one operator cannot recycle the same three sponsors across a farm.
